nodes.label: seaborn.objects
nodes.desc: Public namespace re-exporting Plot, the Mark/Stat/Move classes, and the Scale subclasses.

nodes.label: Plot
nodes.desc: Immutable declarative spec built by add()/facet()/pair()/scale(); Plot._plot() hands it to the engine.

nodes.label: Plotter
nodes.desc: Engine that compiles a Plot spec into a matplotlib figure: scales, stats, layers, legend, finalization.

nodes.label: Subplots
nodes.desc: Turns facet/pair specs into a concrete matplotlib figure grid, handling wrap and axis sharing.

nodes.label: GroupBy
nodes.desc: Ordered pandas grouping helper; stats and moves both consume per-group dataframes through it.

nodes.label: Stat
nodes.desc: Dataclass base for statistical transforms; __call__(data, groupby, orient, scales) returns a dataframe.

nodes.label: Est
nodes.desc: Point estimate plus error bar interval (ci/pi/se/sd) with n_boot=1000 bootstrap samples.

nodes.label: EstimateAggregator
nodes.desc: Bootstrap/shared machinery shared by the objects API and the classic function API.

nodes.label: Mark
nodes.desc: Base class for visual representations; _resolve() maps properties through scales, _plot() adds artists.

nodes.label: Bars
nodes.desc: Bars mark: matplotlib Rectangle artists per group, with baseline and width handling.

nodes.label: Scale
nodes.desc: Base scale mapping data units to visual properties; subclasses choose locators, formatters, transforms.

nodes.label: Continuous
nodes.desc: Numeric scale with norms/functional transforms and tick()/label() configuration methods.
